mapper.select:
SELECT
, NULL AS PARENT_UID FROM BN_DIRECTORY DR WHERE DR.NO = 1

SELECT
, P.UID AS PARENT_UID FROM BN_DIRECTORY DR INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY P ON DR.PARENT_NO = P.NO WHERE DR.PARENT_NO = #{parentNo} ORDER BY NO

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , d.ABSOLUTE_PATH , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d WHERE 1=1 AND d.PARENT_NO = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS da WHERE da.DIR_NO = d.NO AND da.GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} ) ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d WHERE 1=1 AND d.PARENT_NO = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS da WHERE da.DIR_NO = d.NO AND da.GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} ) ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d WHERE 1=1 AND d.PARENT_NO = #{dirNo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS da WHERE da.DIR_NO = d.NO AND da.GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} ) ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT d.NO , d.PARENT_NO , CAST(d.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , d.NAME , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = d.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY d INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY p ON d.PARENT_NO = p.NO WHERE 1=1 AND d.UID = #{parentUid} ORDER BY d.NAME

SELECT DR.NO ,CAST(DR.UID AS VARCHAR) AS UID , DR.NAME , DR.ABSOLUTE_PATH , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BN_DIRECTORY c WHERE c.PARENT_NO = DR.NO) AS HAS_CHILD FROM BN_DIRECTORY DR INNER JOIN BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS DA ON DR.NO = DA.DIR_NO WHERE DA.GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} AND ( DR.PARENT_NO IS NULL OR DR.PARENT_NO NOT IN ( SELECT DIR_NO FROM BN_DIRECTORY_ACCESS WHERE GROUP_NO = #{groupNo} ) ) ORDER BY DR.NAME
